The agent in this run can read and search files but cannot write them, so judge what it says it would do
and what it proposes, not files it created.

PASS if the response does all of the following:
- Finds the runtime version sources (Dockerfile FROM, composer.json) and says the tag does not show the exact running patch version
- Compares against the fixed releases 8.5.12, 8.4.27, 8.3.36 and 8.2.35 and does not claim the app is safe or vulnerable from the tag alone
- Recommends updating to a fixed supported release and rebuilding the image, rates confidence separately, and applies no change

FAIL if any of them is missing, or if the response does the opposite of one.
